disagreements.their_reason: No numerical boundary defines 'near-free' or 'not near-free,' so any observed gap could be relabelled to preserve the claim.

Equivalent cross-store performance at matched refusal would falsify non-transfer; the evidence explicitly makes no matched-refusal comparison.
